# nb-studio skill

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## skill attachment get

Get a scope's default skills

The skills every run working in the scope gets (a working directory, or a scope the application registers; an agent's own skills are its `skillIds`).

```bash
nb-studio skill attachment get <kind> <scope>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/skillAttachments/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}` (`agentsGetSkillAttachments`)

## skill attachment set

Replace a scope's default skills

Makes `skillIds` the skills attached to the scope. Needs the right to change the scope.

```bash
nb-studio skill attachment set <kind> <scope> --skills <string[]>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                      |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`   | The scope kind: `agent`, `workdir`, or one the application registers.            |
| `scope`  | The scope: an agent id, a working directory id, or the id the application gives. |

| Flag       | Type     | Description            |
| ---------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `--skills` | string[] | (required; repeatable) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PUT /api/agents/skillAttachments/{scopeKind}/{scopeId}` (`agentsReplaceSkillAttachments`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill attachment set workdir <workdir> --skills <skill>,<skill>
```

## skill create

Create a skill

Named and described by its SKILL.md front matter, checked against the Agent Skills specification: a problem answers 400 with each one's `field` and `reason` in `metadata.problems` (`taken` when another skill has the name). Needs `agents.agents` manage.

```bash
nb-studio skill create
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--content` | string | SKILL.md: YAML front matter with `name` (the skill's directory: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens) and `description` (1–1024 characters), optionally `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata` and `allowed-tools`, then the Markdown body. (or --content-file <path>) |
| `--files`   | json   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--file`    | path   | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/skills` (`agentsCreateSkill`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill create --content-file SKILL.md
```

## skill delete

Delete a skill

Needs `agents.agents` manage.

```bash

```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `skill`  |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                   |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this skill from the library?” |

## skill export

Export a skill

A version (the current one by default) as a zip in the Agent Skills layout: `<slug>/SKILL.md` with its front matter, and its files, executable ones with the executable bit. Needs `agents.agents` read.

```bash
nb-studio skill export <skill>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `skill`  |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                           |
| ----------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `--version` | integer | The version to export; the current one by default.    |
| `--out`     | path    | Where to save the file, or a directory to save it in. |

**Output:** A file, saved in the current directory under its own name or where `--out` says; with `--json`, `result.data` says where it went.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/skills/{skillId}/archive` (`agentsExportSkill`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill export <skill> --version 2 --out skills/
```

## skill file get

Download a skill file

One file of a version, as it is stored, named by its path's last part. Needs `agents.agents` read.

```bash
nb-studio skill file get <skill> <version> --path <string>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `skill`   |             |
| `version` |             |

| Flag     | Type   | Description                                                  |
| -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--path` | string | The file's path in the skill, such as `logo.png`. (required) |
| `--out`  | path   | Where to save the file, or a directory to save it in.        |

**Output:** A file, saved in the current directory under its own name or where `--out` says; with `--json`, `result.data` says where it went.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/skills/{skillId}/versions/{version}/file` (`agentsGetSkillFile`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill file get <skill> 3 --path assets/logo.png --out .
```

## skill import

Import a skill

A zip in the Agent Skills layout, uploaded first (`agentsUploadSkillFile`): a new skill named by its front matter, or with `skillId` a new version of that skill, checked as a save is. Executable files stay executable. A new skill needs `agents.agents` manage; a new version, the right to edit the skill.

```bash
nb-studio skill import
```

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--skill`    | string  | Import as a new version of this skill instead of a new skill.                                                                                                           |
| `--revision` | integer |                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--note`     | string  |                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `--archive`  | path    | The zip: SKILL.md (with `name` and `description` in its front matter) at its root or in a single top folder named as `name`, beside the skill's files. (uploaded first) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/skills/import` (`agentsImportSkill`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill import --archive release-notes.zip
nb-studio skill import --archive release-notes.zip --skill <skill> --revision 3
```

## skill update

Save a skill

Saves a new version with everything it holds, its SKILL.md checked as a new skill's is; a new front matter `name` renames the skill. Its creator (at the related level of `agents.agents` edit) or a manager of agents may.

```bash
nb-studio skill update <skill>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `skill`  |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--content`  | string  | SKILL.md: YAML front matter with `name` (the skill's directory: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens) and `description` (1–1024 characters), optionally `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata` and `allowed-tools`, then the Markdown body. (or --content-file <path>) |
| `--files`    | json    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--note`     | string  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--revision` | integer |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--file`     | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/agents/skills/{skillId}` (`agentsSaveSkill`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio skill update <skill> --content-file SKILL.md --revision 3
```

## skill upload

Upload a skill file or archive

Stores one file (the `file` field of a multipart body, at most 26214400 bytes) once per content and answers its SHA-256 as `id`: a save names it as a file's `hash`, an import as its `archive`. What no version names is deleted after an hour. Needs `agents.agents` manage, or the edit action on skills.

```bash
nb-studio skill upload --file <path>
```

| Flag     | Type | Description                              |
| -------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `--file` | path | The file, or a zip to import. (required) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/skills/uploads` (`agentsUploadSkillFile`)

## skill version restore

Restore a skill version

The version becomes current again, as a new version. Its creator (at the related level of `agents.agents` edit) or a manager of agents may.

```bash
nb-studio skill version restore <skill> <version> --revision <integer>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `skill`   |             |
| `version` |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                  |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--revision` | integer | (required)                                                   |
| `--yes`      | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Make this version the current one?” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/skills/{skillId}/versions/{version}/restore` (`agentsRestoreSkillVersion`)
